title: melicytus ramiflorus subsp. samoensis
intro: Melicytus ramiflorus subsp. samoensis, commonly known as the Samoan forget-me-not, is a plant species native to Samoa and other Pacific Island nations. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Melicytus ramiflorus subsp. samoensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
